Grow Faster. We’re always looking for the ones truly passionate about their work. If you are amongst them, you can rest assured there is a place for you in eMAG. We grew very fast and we are determined to keep doing so. What brought us here is our desire for continuous evolution and practical results. At eMAG, a set of strong principles guide our daily work: we understand the client, we think like a successful entrepreneur, we make decisions supported by data, we assess the impact of our projects, we act responsibly, we support each other and we grow with the business. They define us and help us become the favorite shopping destination for our clients. Almost 6000 people are working now in eMAG. We strongly believe in people development and therefore every year we invest more and more energy and resources to remain an organization that is constantly learning. We want to make sure that you’ll have the most talented colleagues, as well as the proper environment to grow and achieve great results, to become what you desire on a personal and professional level.

Join us, grow faster!    DevOps Engineer (Data & AI, Data Operations Team)    Join our Data Operations Team as an DevOps Engineer and play a key role in building a cutting-edge ML Platform on Google Cloud from the ground up--shaping the future of scalable, automated machine learning across the organization. What youll have to do: Managing and optimizing ML workflows in Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Functions, and BigQuery ML; integrating CI/CD pipelines for model training and deployment; monitoring and automating model performance and retraining in Kubernetes-based environments; Define and manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform; Configuring and tuning a variety of services in order to increase system stability, performance and security; Capacity planning and performance tuning for high traffic events such as Black Friday; Adding observability and alerting to data pipelines and services; Testing new technologies and industry trends and assessing their fitness for our needs; Sharing technical expertise and helping data engineers and data scientists implement best practices that maximize performance and security; Identifying repetitive issues or tasks and focus on automation and implementation of permanent solutions. What makes you a good fit: Have very good knowledge of Google Cloud Platform, Linux environments, containers and container orchestration solutions (Kubernetes); Have experience with at least one programming language (Python, Java, Ruby, PHP, etc), Shell scripting and regular expressions; Have solid understanding of best practices around software development, release engineering and CI/CD; Have good understanding of networking, operating systems, automation, distributed computing, high availability and load balancing concepts. What makes you stand out: Prior experience in managing modern ML Platforms and Big Data highly-available systems; HashiCorp tools - Vault, Consul, Terraform; Experience with public cloud platforms - AWS, CGP, Azure, etc.; Knowledge of monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, StatsD, ELK stack, LGTM stack, etc); Development experience in SQL, proficiency with relational databases and SQL queries; Active member of the community. What weve prepared for you: Medical subscription: Medicover, MedLife or Regina Maria.  A flexible budget that you can invest in yourself as you wish: meal tickets, holiday tickets, cultural vouchers, private pension, foreign language classes, eMAG, Fashion Days, Therme & Genius, membership to different gyms or even professional development classes.   Different discounts from our partners: banking, mobile, dental medicine or wellness.   Access to the Bookster library and free credits on the Hilio psycho-emotional health platform.  An accelerated learning environment, with access to over 100.000 curated online resources and platforms, learning academies and development programs.  New headquarters, where sleek design, natural light, and versatile spaces create an energizing and comfortable environment for hybrid work.  Curious to find out more about the next step in your career? Apply now and if your experience is relevant for the role you wish, we will give you a call for more details! Also, here you can find our confidentiality policy if you want to consult it.
